goal: Tile drag and keyboard reorder (I7a, Board gate 189 keyboard reorder): tiles.js with pointer-event drag, Alt+Arrow on the move handle, aria-live announcement, per-dataset order store.

acceptance_criteria.text: app/static/js/tiles.js (local, deferred after dashboard.js in dataset.html): pointerdown on .ws-head or figcaption (not on a button, link, select or input) of tile A and pointerup over tile B moves A into B's place in the DOM (B.before(A) if A came after B, else B.after(A)); .ws-move has touch-action none
Alt+ArrowLeft/ArrowUp on .ws-move moves its tile one place earlier, Alt+ArrowRight/ArrowDown one later; focus stays on the handle; #ws-live text contains '<label> moved to position <i> of <n>'

After each move localStorage['databoot.order.<dataset id>.<app>'] holds the tile keys; on load stored keys come first in stored order and the rest follow in default order; another dataset keeps its default order; Tab order equals visual order

Playwright on the survey fixture (tests/test_tile_interactions.py): drag_to from tile 3's header onto tile 1 changes the data-tile order as specified, a reload keeps it, the monitor dataset keeps its default order; focus .ws-move on tile 2, Alt+ArrowLeft makes it first, #ws-live contains 'position 1 of' and document.activeElement is still the handle
No request leaves the app, no console errors; python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_tile_interactions.py tests/test_survey_page.py passes
Moves acceptance items AC-81, AC-86 forward

decisions.what: tests/test_tiles.py serve fixture now joins each server thread (10 s) after setting should_exit
decisions.why: Without the join, the server's lifespan upload.cleanup() ran during the next module and cleared upload._batches, so test_upload's second send got a 404
decisions.evidence: tests/test_tiles.py:28-45; pytest tests/test_tiles.py tests/test_upload.py failed before (1 failed) and passed after (30 passed); check.py tests: 461 passed

assumptions: test_AC_59's failure in the first full run was the known hover flake: it passed alone twice and in the second full run
open_questions: test_AC_59 (map hover in the protected tests/test_acceptance.py) is still flaky under load; per gate 190 it needs a QA ticket to make it deterministic

lessons.lesson: When a test passes alone but fails in the full run, rerun it right after the module sorted just before it. Any live-uvicorn fixture must join its thread after should_exit, because the lifespan shutdown (upload.cleanup) clears module-global state
lessons.when: order-dependent failures in a suite that starts uvicorn servers in threads

lessons.lesson: On a retry whose earlier attempts reported 'no change', run the orchestrator's check command itself: the failure may be in a different file
lessons.when: retry ticket where the ticket's own tests already pass
lessons.evidence: /tmp/check.log first run: test_upload failed, not the ticket's tests
